name: Teirei
source:
A shikigami and a faithful servant of [url=https://vndb.org/c34800]Madara Yakou[/url]. He is not the only one of his shikigami; the other one is [url=https://vndb.org/c34806]Niko[/url].

Teirei has a sober, honest, and polite personality. He is very restrained, even if he faces a person whom he deems unpleasant. It is easier to deal with him rather than with [url=https://vndb.org/c34806]Niko[/url].

For some reason, he does not like [url=https://vndb.org/c34802]Kyougetsu Keishirou[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c34803]Sakuya[/url].
